vanadium is a versatile metal ion for the study of biological processes.

The main takeaway from our work is that
vanadate can be used to assemble high-order complexes with protein substrates, even those with unusual substrates.
vanadate can be a useful tool for capturing the transition state for a phosphoryl transfer enzyme, even when the substrate is a large, complicated, multi-component assembly.
vanadate is not just a useful tool for studying phosphodiesterases, but can be used to study a wide array of phosphoryl transfer enzymes.
